segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most commonly report the toner balances oil and controls shine without stripping or making skin feel greasy.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, often described as combo-to-oily, report it controls excess oil in the T-zone while keeping cheeks hydrated.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally report the fragrance-free formula does not irritate or dry them out, though one reviewer's partner with sensitive skin found it slightly drying.
segments.dry: A few reviewers with dry skin report it still hydrates without over-drying, including one who says it added glow without over-oiling.

concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers report visibly less oil and shine through the day, though a couple say they noticed no change in oiliness or that it did not absorb their excess oil.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers report the jelly toner hydrates rather than drying out the skin, including some with dry skin who found it added moisture without heaviness.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report gradual improvement in acne or breakouts with continued use, but one reviewer states the toner did nothing besides break her out.

extraits.titre: A step up for your skincare
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have always used Thayer's products and love the original witch hazel, so I was excited to try this new formulation. It resembles the original but has a thicker consistency that absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling sticky, making it ideal for summer use. However, as someone with oily, sensitive skin, I found that leaving it on overnight resulted in excessive moisture, which I dislike. To address this, I devised a method of applying it on a cotton pad to create a mask, leaving it on my face for 15 minutes before rinsing and continuing with my skincare routine. This approach has proven effective, as my skin feels light while still reaping the benefits of the formula.

I only gave 4/5 stars because I hate the texture- but I can look past it for all of the other benefits this product offers! After I cleanse my face and gently exfoiliate I use this product as directed by putting it on a cotton pad and swiping it on my face. IT IS IMPORTANT THAT YOU LET THE PRODUCT DRY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE mainly because it works better if you let it dry. it leaves a soft matte finish, and still keeps my skin hydrated! I use it every morning and night as directed!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This toner is a refreshing and lightweight toner. I have combination skin and this worked well for my skin. The product says it works well for combo to oily skin. It's jelly like texture glides smoothly, absorbing quickly without leaving a sticky residue. It has helped control excess oil, minimize the appearance of pores. Love it's gentle feel. However my partner tried it too but she has sensitive skin and she felt it was slightly drying. But overall I like this toner.

extraits.titre: sensitive skin girlies, to the front!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] if regular toners strip or are too intense on your skin, this is definitely the toner for you. personally, it wasn't intense enough for me, but i did use this on other parts of my body and it worked great with balancing the oils. it gradually does help with things like acne control (and this dark spots), but once again, its gradual.

extraits.titre: Oil toner is great for dry skin
extraits.texte: I received this product free for my review. I had never tried an oil toner before but was intrigued due to my dry skin. I had been using this product for a little bit now and it has helped added some oil to my face. A tiny bit goes a long ways as it's a little thick. The scent is non scented which is perfect for face products. It has helped added a little glow without over oiling my face.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love the texture of this product. It truly has a cooling effect when you use it. It's a bonus that the product is vegan and has no scent. The toner keeps you hydrated all day even though I have dry skin. Would recommend.
